sections.text:
Sepam series 40, with its current and voltage metering capabilities, 
offers high performing solutions for more demanding applications. Sepam series 
40 units perform the following functions in addition to those performed by Sepam 
series 20:

Protection of closed ring networks or networks with parallel incomers, by 
directional protection directional earth fault protection suitable for all 
earthing systems: impudent, isolated or compensated neutral protection of 
networks with variable configurations requiring the switching of groups of 
settings and logic discrimination

All the necessary electrical measurements: phase and residual currents, phase-to 
neutral, phase-to-phase and residual voltage, frequency, power and energy,

Comprehensive network diagnosis assistance: 20 seconds of disturbance recording, 
detailed history of the last 200 alarms, storage of the last 5 tripping contexts
Adaptation of control functions by a logical equation editor

Customization of alarm messages to fit each application, and/or in the users 
language

The first is initiated by eng. Mohamed Hamed Mesbah, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef, 
revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gilil: MDEPC quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria 
power station, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.

Wear 
 your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

items: A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Line isolation is required.

Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the 
 current circuits for test distance protection.
Feeder must be grounded.

ISA DRTS tester, Test leads.
PC laptop with necessary software {ISAWIZARD and ENER VISTA}
Tools bag.

sections.text:
Steps to 
prepare for 
relay testing

items:
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolate the relay current circuits for test.

Be sure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying a DC voltmeter 
 across (FA1-A points (1,2) on the rear of the relay see figure no. 1.

sections.text:
Reading the Setting from the 
Relay using the PC

items: Connect the personal computer to the relay.
Run the Sepam program.

Read the setting and safe it as URGENT FILE FOR SIPROTEC SEPAM M41 [name the 
 feeder].
Be sure that ISA tester is connected to EARTH.
Switch ON ISA tester.
Connect the Personal Computer to the ISA tester.
Insert test plug to XT3 see figure 1

After ISA tester completely in service Connect Currents, Voltages and binary 
 input leads between ISA tester and SEPAM M41.
Insert the current terminals to XT13 points (1,2,3,4) see figure no.1
Disable other functions.

RUN ISAWIZARD software>>>>>GENERATION & DISTRIBUTION RELAYS>>>> Xpro 
 advanced>>>>MANUAL MODE

NOW you can test the relay.
 NOTE: Don't forget to GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=0V].
SET time over current = 0 [Ie instantaneous over current]
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay.
Set time over current to set value.

Choose Shoot with current values [2*I,3*1,4*I and 5*I] to get these points on 
 curve.
STORE ALL TESTS

sections.text:
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service

items: Enable any function which was disabled.

Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set.
Make sure CT and VT secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Remove the disturbance alarm LED`s on the relay which is caused by the test.
Request feeder to be returned in service.

Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to 
 those for normal load condition.

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, MVAR, Amperes and 
 power factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.

Introduction
Sepam series 40, with its current and voltage metering capabilities, 
offers high performing solutions for more demanding applications. Sepam series 
40 units perform the following functions in addition to those performed by Sepam 
series 20:
Protection of closed ring networks or networks with parallel incomers, by 
directional protection directional earth fault protection suitable for all 
earthing systems: impudent, isolated or compensated neutral protection of 
networks with variable configurations requiring the switching of groups of 
settings and logic discrimination
All the necessary electrical measurements: phase and residual currents, phase-to 
neutral, phase-to-phase and residual voltage, frequency, power and energy,
Comprehensive network diagnosis assistance: 20 seconds of disturbance recording, 
detailed history of the last 200 alarms, storage of the last 5 tripping contexts
Adaptation of control functions by a logical equation editor
Customization of alarm messages to fit each application, and/or in the users 
language
The first is initiated by eng. Mohamed Hamed Mesbah, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef, 
revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gilil: MDEPC quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria

 your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

Line isolation is required.

 current circuits for test distance protection.
Feeder must be grounded.
